submittedPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One complete full desktop DooKnow favorites INITIAL LOADING page, about 1440x1000. Image 1 gives real content/geometry; Image 2 gives global header and compact flat styling. Preserve the real DooKnow book identity and full horizontal global header as in Image 2. A narrow left owner rail has account O, 笔记/最近/收藏/应用, bottom 回收站/设置. Keep the contextual sidebar and its search field, 新建 split button, contextual heading, add-folder and refresh icons, and resize divider. No invented navigation or header actions. Select 收藏 in the rail.
Context sidebar heading 收藏, then only 暂无收藏，可右键笔记或在编辑窗口中收藏. No sidebar note entries or 查看全部. Main heading hierarchy 我的笔记 then 收藏, 0 篇笔记 and 按最近修改排序. Main refresh is disabled, 新建笔记 remains enabled. Main body is exactly six quiet skeleton cards in a three-column two-row grid, not the empty-content illustration from Image 1. This is a single coherent initial-loading state with no cards/pagination/error. Flat white #ffffff main/header, #f7f8fa context sidebar, #272b3a text, #657084 muted, #e6e9f1 thin borders, #4566c6 blue and #edf1ff selection. Crisp Chinese sans-serif, 8px corners, no texture/gradient. Preserve DooKnow global horizontal header across top. No browser chrome, task identity or extra navigation. Source/role/state caption is metadata.
